primary_claims: post-hoc-threshold-free exact sparsity for Xneural VAR and NGC/cMLP
Granger graph recovery on linear VAR and Neural-GC Lorenz-96 settings
protocol.lorenz_reference: Tank et al. Neural Granger Causality, published TPAMI version; T=500 condition
protocol.xneural_ngc_binary_rule: group norm > 0 exactly; no post-hoc threshold and no top-k
protocol.linear_var_binary_rule: joint all-lag F-test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05
protocol.calibration: one separate calibration seed; five evaluation seeds are not used for hyperparameter selection
